Reproducer: https://godbolt.org/z/eee7PTqGo
Testcase:
```
target datalayout = "e-m:e-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-f80:128-n8:16:32:64-S128"
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

define double @func_1() {
entry:
  %shuffle6.bc.i = bitcast <8 x i16> <i16 undef, i16 undef, i16 undef, i16 undef, i16 0, i16 0, i16 0, i16 0> to <2 x double>
  %shuffle6.extract.i = extractelement <2 x double> %shuffle6.bc.i, i64 0
  %0 = bitcast double %shuffle6.extract.i to <4 x i16>
  %1 = or <4 x i16> <i16 1, i16 1, i16 1, i16 1>, %0
  %2 = bitcast <4 x i16> %1 to double
  ret double %2
}
```

comments.author: RKSimon
comments.body:
```
Optimized legalized selection DAG: %bb.0 'func_1:entry'
SelectionDAG has 11 nodes:
  t0: ch,glue = EntryToken
        t30: i64 = X86ISD::Wrapper TargetConstantPool:i64<<8 x i16> <i16 1, i16 1, i16 1, i16 1, i16 undef, i16 undef, i16 undef, i16 undef>> 0
      t34: f64,ch = load<(load (s64) from constant-pool, align 16)> t0, t30, undef:i64
    t17: f64 = X86ISD::FOR undef:f64, t34
  t14: ch,glue = CopyToReg t0, Register:f64 $xmm0, t17
  t15: ch = X86ISD::RET_GLUE t14, TargetConstant:i32<0>, Register:f64 $xmm0, t14:1
```
We don't canonicalise / fold away the undef while its still a X86ISD::FOR node, so it waits until DAGToDAGISel and then starts constant folding.... `FOR(undef,x) -> OR(undef,x) -> OR(x,undef) -> -1`
